blocks.text: Calligraphy L0-09 · Hamza, madda, alif maqṣūra, tanwīn, alif waṣla
⁧ء⁩ hamza · ʾ · /ʔ/ Glottis. Alone on the line or above/under a support (⁧أ إ ؤ ئ⁩).
⁧ى⁩ alif maqṣūra · ā · [aː] ā final written with a ⁧ي⁩ without points.
⁧أ⁩ alif with hamza above · ʾ · /ʔ/ Hamza support: you read the glottis stroke plus the vowel.
⁧إ⁩ alif with hamza under · ʾ · /ʔ/ Hamza support: you read the glottis stroke plus the vowel.
⁧آ⁩ alif madda · ʾ · /ʔ/ Hamza support: you read the glottis stroke plus the vowel.
⁧ؤ⁩ hamza on wāw · ʾ · /ʔ/ Hamza support: you read the glottis stroke plus the vowel.
⁧ئ⁩ hamza on yāʾ no points · ʾ · /ʔ/ Hamza support: you read the glottis stroke plus the vowel.
